source_review.rationale: Same-unit matrix definition, consumed negative X terms and shift copy reproduce the complete retail allocation.

limits: Three complete matching source units and their compiled initialized tables execute; no callee stubs or instruction patches.
The independent oracle composes quantized axes and checks all nine output words for both retail and candidate executions.
Every masked phase is exercised separately on each axis, with Cartesian boundary and deterministic full-width input cases.
Code/read/write bounds, call arguments, unchanged complete FrameView, matrix/stack canaries, SP, GP and saved GPRs are checked.
This is bounded CPU execution, without a complete game, graphics microcode or hardware proof.
The complete compiled function and its existing matrix definition are independently verified; matrix storage adds no new BSS bytes.
This private type probe does not own code or storage.

progress.note: Unmeasured bytes include padding, header, boot, fallback code/data and assets; ROM equality is not source completion. Source-owned BSS consumes no ROM bytes.

limits: The 428-byte function is complete; instruction alignment adds no code ownership.
The 36-byte matrix was already source-owned and is moved without new storage credit.
Finite CPU fixtures do not prove arbitrary aliases, graphics microcode, hardware or full gameplay.
Other fallback and unclassified CPU ranges remain; full-ROM equality does not establish full decompilation.
